standard_prerequisites.name: The scheme case for a monomorphism towards a field

standard_prerequisites.name: Density and monomorphismhood force Z' = Z in the isomorphism case

core_obligations: Show that Z is separated using the two separatedness lemmas (proof lines 2006-2009).
Choose an open dense subspace Z' of Z which is a scheme (proof lines 2009-2012).
Apply the scheme case to Z' -> Spec(k) to get that Z' is empty or isomorphic to Spec(k) (proof lines 2013-2015).
Conclude Z empty in the first case and Z' = Z = Spec(k) in the second, using that Z -> Spec(k) is a monomorphism (proof lines 2016-2019).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: if Z -> Spec(k) is a monomorphism of algebraic spaces over a field k, then Z is either empty or isomorphic to Spec(k) (source lines 1998-2003). The proof first shows Z is separated, hence has an open dense subspace Z' which is a scheme, then applies the scheme statement that a monomorphism towards the spectrum of a field is either empty or an isomorphism: in the empty case Z is empty, and in the isomorphism case the monomorphism property forces Z' = Z = Spec(k).
